_comment: What the stub judge answers. Layer it in front of the stage replies:
A judge is asked a different question, in dossier's own wrapper (R7.19):
the rubric, the document, the candidate inside <claim>...</claim>, and
'Answer with JSON only'. Each rule matches on that opening tag plus the
first words of one candidate -- anchored there, because a phrase from the
candidate alone would also match every other candidate about the same
document, the whole of which is in the prompt.
The last six rules are the run's own root_cause answers rather than
sample cases: `dossier eval` puts each of them to the judge too (R7.17).
This stub agrees with all forty human verdicts, so both states measure
100%. Flip one and watch the state it belongs to move on its own.
